test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘PAIDY’ is written as ‘NYGBW’, and ‘FORST’ is written as ‘DMPQR’. How will ‘HARKG’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, ‘PAIDY’ is written as ‘NYGBW’,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47feb2657b0e7f5ed6ff7f1eccc22cff867d277a567670955877cc940c7b3530.png] 

For, ‘FORST’ is written as ‘DMPQR’,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3970aba82bc1dde0d27c9a8830be882df2a38622debf6dbf6f87d8f3acf5f8c9.png] 

Similarly, for HARKG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/39f121a2497b279d1a76fba6b7792b95f350a72c4ec6d244c3baff6df254d915.png] 

So, 'HARKG' will be written as 'FYPIE'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
